title: Dilo pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai hussain hai
body:
Dilo pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain hai, hussain hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke deen ki jo abhi shaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khuda ko jis pe naaz hai wohi meri namaz hai
wohi hai kaaba e yaqee'n wohi to chara saaz hai
wo jiske dum se aaj tak azaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Wo jiska zikr aaj bhi waseela e nijaat hai
wo jiske qarz ke tale dabee ye kayenaat hai
jo apne dushmano pe sayebaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kise kaha rasool ne dilo ka chayn yaad kar
hussain o minni wa ana minal hussain yaad kar
hadees e mustafa ka tarjumaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Karam ki hadd hussain hai jafa ka radd hussain hai
namaaz kibriya ki hai magar sanad hussain hai
jo marziye khuda e meherbaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kisi ke darr pe jau kyu kahi pe sar jhukau kyu
mai apna haale dil kisi bhi ghayr ko sunau kyu
meri duao'n ka jo paas baan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aqeeda jo kahe use likhe wo mazhar aabdi
hussain meri zindagi hussain meri bandagi
meri aqeedato ki jo zabaan hai
<<MINI>>
hussain hai, hussain hai, hussain hai.... hussain hai
dilo'n pe aaj bhi jo hukmaran hai, hussain haii..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
hussainn hai, hussain haii...
